text:
Maya (CS): quick heads-up — we discovered an SSO token sync failure that affected a cohort of private/onboard customers last night. some onboarding jobs stalled and a few sessions returned 401s. I flagged the impacted tenants list in the doc: https://redwood.share/incident/1719873210 :warning:

IncidentBot: INCIDENT-2026-1719 | Severity: P2 | Affected: ~14 onboarding tenants | Escalated to eng oncall

Ethan (Onboard): copying the list — most are mid-onboard, 6 in trial close-to-renewal. this could be a renewal risk if we don't reach out quickly.

Maya (CS): Agreed. Proposed comm plan: 1) Immediate status email to impacted contacts; 2) Offer a one-off "concierge" enablement session + 7 days of free credits; 3) 1:1 CS outreach for high-touch accounts (the 6 renewal-risk ones). Need wording + legal sign-off.

Priya (Eng): root cause: token refresh job failed after a schema drift in our onboarding sync service. already deployed a fix at 03:12 UTC, jobs backfilled. we'll attach a short RCA bullet list.

Jules (Legal): ok to offer credits and enablement. keep wording careful on liability — nothing that admits broader SLA breach unless SRE confirms. I can review the draft by EOD.

Sam (Support): I'll queue up the support ticket template and set a high urgency tag. also adding a step to capture NPS-style feedback after the enablement call.

Maya (CS): Draft email snippet for review (short):

"Hi <Name>,

We want to let you know about an issue that affected authentication during parts of last night which impacted onboarding sessions. The issue has been resolved and we completed a backfill. We're sorry for the disruption. To make this right, we'd like to offer a complimentary 1:1 enablement session and 7 days of credits. If you'd like us to prioritize your migration, reply and we'll schedule immediately.

— Maya, Customer Success"

Priya (Eng): LGTM. pls include a 1-paragraph RCA for transparency. something like: "Cause: schema mismatch in token sync job; Fix: patch + backfill; Impact: transient 401s for scheduled onboarding jobs between 01:40–03:12 UTC; Mitigation: added schema validation and alerting."

Ethan (Onboard): I'll send the email to the trial contacts list and do 1:1 outreach for the 6 at-risk accounts. Maya — can you own the scheduling for enablement sessions?

Maya (CS): yes, I'll own scheduling + logging outcomes in the tracker. I'll also add a short survey link at the end of the session to capture immediate feedback and renewal sentiment.

Leo (CS Manager): Add a checklist for renewals team to offer an extra month credit if the customer signals churn risk. we should escalate to AMs for any account that flags renewal concerns.

Maya (CS): noted. Action items I'm taking:
- send the status email to all impacted within 1 hour (owner: Maya)
- schedule enablement sessions for any who reply 'yes' (owner: Maya)
- 1:1 outreach to 6 renewal-risk tenants (owner: Ethan)
- legal review of copy (owner: Jules)
- support ticket templates + survey (owner: Sam)
- RCA blurb from Eng to include in email (owner: Priya)

Sam (Support): I'll create a canned reply and tag the tickets with "incident-1719873210". also will add a timeline to each ticket: "issue window: 2026-03-21 01:40–03:12 UTC"

Jules (Legal): Draft reviewed. small tweak on phrasing to avoid implied SLA. updated sentence suggestion: "We completed a targeted remediation and backfill; we will continue monitoring to ensure stable onboarding flows."

Priya (Eng): Confirmed monitoring targets added and an alert created for schema drift. I'll push a short postmortem doc link to the incident doc by EOD.

Maya (CS): plan to start outreach now. I'll post a quick summary here after the first 5 touchpoints.

Ethan (Onboard): quick ask — can eng create a minimal troubleshooting checklist we can run during calls? token refresh cache clear + re-run job. small snippet ok.

Priya (Eng): added a one-click checklist in the doc: `clear-token-cache -> trigger-refresh -> verify session 200s`

Maya (CS): thanks. also want to capture a short survey after enablement:
- How disruptive was this on a scale of 1–5?
- Did our remediation/help resolve your immediate needs? (yes/no)
- Would you like proactive help finishing onboarding? (yes/no)

Leo (CS Manager): good. once we have survey + call outcomes, we'll map back to renewal risk and propose credits. keep me posted.

Maya (CS): final note: for transparency, we will send a brief RCA follow-up in 48 hours and offer a live office hour next week for anyone wanting a walkthrough.

IncidentBot: NOTE: incident tagged for postmortem tracking. PM assigned: Priya (Eng).

Maya (CS): thanks all — I'll post the outbound copy in 15 and start sending. :thumbsup:
